summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy and ruff are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and lint were checked by reading only. I also put the arg-type type-ignore on the parse call rather than on the pytest.raises line, and left out a None-input test because its outcome depends on graph contents.
